DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: What can you tell me about Saradomin?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: What can you tell me about Saradomin?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: What can you tell me about Kuldra?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: What can you tell me about Kuldra?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: What can you tell me about the dragonkin?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: What can you tell me about the dragonkin?

Message.SourceString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!
Message.LocalizedString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!

Message.SourceString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!
Message.LocalizedString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!

Message.SourceString: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.
Message.LocalizedString: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.

Message.SourceString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!
Message.LocalizedString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!

Message.SourceString: Where shall I take you?
Message.LocalizedString: Where shall I take you?

Message.SourceString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!
Message.LocalizedString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!

Message.SourceString: Ah, but your burden is too great right now. Come speak to me when you have divested yourself of some of what you carry.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, but your burden is too great right now. Come speak to me when you have divested yourself of some of what you carry.

Message.SourceString: The door opens with disturbing ease.
Message.LocalizedString: The door opens with disturbing ease.

Message.SourceString: You step away.
Message.LocalizedString: You step away.

Message.SourceString: The lord of the skies has fallen. Xikotal, slain by Kuldra's fury.
Message.LocalizedString: The lord of the skies has fallen. Xikotal, slain by Kuldra's fury.

Message.SourceString: Dragons, they seem to have so many heads, don't they? Let me take that one from you.
Message.LocalizedString: Dragons, they seem to have so many heads, don't they? Let me take that one from you.

Message.SourceString: The blood of the four seal this gate. One of earth, one of water, one of air and one of flame.
Message.LocalizedString: The blood of the four seal this gate. One of earth, one of water, one of air and one of flame.

Message.SourceString: Well... I say moved on, I sometimes wonder whether times ever really change.
Message.LocalizedString: Well... I say moved on, I sometimes wonder whether times ever really change.

Message.SourceString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!
Message.LocalizedString: May Saradomin guide and watch over you! And may Kuldra know his wrath! TO BATTLE!

Message.SourceString: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.
Message.LocalizedString: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.

Message.SourceString: Gentle Imaru, blessed by water, finally rests in peace.
Message.LocalizedString: Gentle Imaru, blessed by water, finally rests in peace.

Message.SourceString: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.
Message.LocalizedString: The scaled blight has been slain. Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth.

Message.SourceString: It's wise to plan and prepare, but don't take too long. Kuldra's readying herself to unleash a catastrophe across Gielinor that could see the end of everything.
Message.LocalizedString: It's wise to plan and prepare, but don't take too long. Kuldra's readying herself to unleash a catastrophe across Gielinor that could see the end of everything.

Message.SourceString: Welcome back, friend of the Moon Garou. I hope the magic carpet is serving you well.
Message.LocalizedString: Welcome back, friend of the Moon Garou. I hope the magic carpet is serving you well.

Message.SourceString: Be careful if you happen to use it with the Leggings of Lightness. I can't guarantee your safety.
Message.LocalizedString: Be careful if you happen to use it with the Leggings of Lightness. I can't guarantee your safety.

Message.SourceString: You carry the Staff of Lougrim, our foremother! Bless the stars!
Message.LocalizedString: You carry the Staff of Lougrim, our foremother! Bless the stars!

Message.SourceString: My natural instinct is to tell you to bring it to Uzzer or Manafem, that they have better claim to it, but things have changed in the Sands.
Message.LocalizedString: My natural instinct is to tell you to bring it to Uzzer or Manafem, that they have better claim to it, but things have changed in the Sands.

Message.SourceString: I see, well then...
Message.LocalizedString: I see, well then...

Message.SourceString: They look to us now. Alcarrid leads. And we shall lead with the Staff of Lougrim.
Message.LocalizedString: They look to us now. Alcarrid leads. And we shall lead with the Staff of Lougrim.

Message.SourceString: Please, I offer this in return. Perhaps Lougrim will guide you as much as she guided us.
Message.LocalizedString: Please, I offer this in return. Perhaps Lougrim will guide you as much as she guided us.

Message.SourceString: There is a stillness in the Underworld. A quietude. You have achieved something remarkable.
Message.LocalizedString: There is a stillness in the Underworld. A quietude. You have achieved something remarkable.

Message.SourceString: You have not just become a legend. You have become THE legend of Ashenfall - the one that all the other stories build towards.
Message.LocalizedString: You have not just become a legend. You have become THE legend of Ashenfall - the one that all the other stories build towards.

Message.SourceString: While I may be immortal, I can be forgotten. In your case, there is no chance of being forgotten at all. Your legacy is cast in iron.
Message.LocalizedString: While I may be immortal, I can be forgotten. In your case, there is no chance of being forgotten at all. Your legacy is cast in iron.

Message.SourceString: Hrmm, here a bit soon arne't you? Shouldn't you take out the generals before facing the queen?
Message.LocalizedString: Hrmm, here a bit soon arne't you? Shouldn't you take out the generals before facing the queen?

Message.SourceString: Pause your run and return to Zilyana?
Message.LocalizedString: Pause your run and return to Zilyana?

Message.SourceString: The teleporter hums to life.
Message.LocalizedString: The teleporter hums to life.

Message.SourceString: You step away.
Message.LocalizedString: You step away.

Message.SourceString: Gentle Imaru, blessed by water, finally rests in peace.
Message.LocalizedString: Gentle Imaru, blessed by water, finally rests in peace.

Message.SourceString: Ah, but your burden is too great right now. Come speak to me when you have divested yourself of some of what you carry.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, but your burden is too great right now. Come speak to me when you have divested yourself of some of what you carry.

Message.SourceString: Fuzan's flames have been extinguished.
Message.LocalizedString: Fuzan's flames have been extinguished.

Message.SourceString: The gate stands open, destiny awaits.
Message.LocalizedString: The gate stands open, destiny awaits.

Message.SourceString: Which is why I need you to finish this threat, once and for all. Kuldra's threatening all of Gielinor now. Shockwaves of discordant anima have been blasting out from this place and they're getting stronger with each wave.
Message.LocalizedString: Which is why I need you to finish this threat, once and for all. Kuldra's threatening all of Gielinor now. Shockwaves of discordant anima have been blasting out from this place and they're getting stronger with each wave.

Message.SourceString: My lord, Saradomin, has called me here to help deal with the threat, but the anima here... it's like it drains me, I feel myself weakening the closer I get to her tower. So I'm afraid I have to pass the torch to you.
Message.LocalizedString: My lord, Saradomin, has called me here to help deal with the threat, but the anima here... it's like it drains me, I feel myself weakening the closer I get to her tower. So I'm afraid I have to pass the torch to you.

Message.SourceString: This island will make a vital base, take some time to set yourself up for success. There will be no raids or anything here, I'll see to that.
Message.LocalizedString: This island will make a vital base, take some time to set yourself up for success. There will be no raids or anything here, I'll see to that.

Message.SourceString: Be sure you're as prepared as you can be. Are you ready to kill the queen?
Message.LocalizedString: Be sure you're as prepared as you can be. Are you ready to kill the queen?

Message.SourceString: We should put a stop to that, as soon as possible.
Message.LocalizedString: We should put a stop to that, as soon as possible.

Message.SourceString: Alas, there will be no statues in your honour on the mainland. Nor will bards sing songs of your deeds, for Guthix's veil will prevent your legend escaping these isles for now.
Message.LocalizedString: Alas, there will be no statues in your honour on the mainland. Nor will bards sing songs of your deeds, for Guthix's veil will prevent your legend escaping these isles for now.

Message.SourceString: But the people here will remember the good you have done, and in time we will find a way to let the world know of your heroism.
Message.LocalizedString: But the people here will remember the good you have done, and in time we will find a way to let the world know of your heroism.

Message.SourceString: Here, let me take that vile trophy from you, so that I might reward you with something more fitting your stature than this... slimy mess.
Message.LocalizedString: Here, let me take that vile trophy from you, so that I might reward you with something more fitting your stature than this... slimy mess.

Message.SourceString: For centuries I have served as the leader of his armies and herald of his divine wisdom.
Message.LocalizedString: For centuries I have served as the leader of his armies and herald of his divine wisdom.

Message.SourceString: I am of the icyene, a race of proud, winged warriors, from the world of Hallow. The seat of Saradomin's power.
Message.LocalizedString: I am of the icyene, a race of proud, winged warriors, from the world of Hallow. The seat of Saradomin's power.

Message.SourceString: Until comparatively recently I had been frozen in time, trapped in the God Wars even though the world had moved on.
Message.LocalizedString: Until comparatively recently I had been frozen in time, trapped in the God Wars even though the world had moved on.

Message.SourceString: Bandos wielded his power like a club. Zamorak uses his to form pacts with demonic creatures seeking to spread corruption and dismay. While Armadyl cowers from his, unwilling to fully shoulder  the burden of godhood.
Message.LocalizedString: Bandos wielded his power like a club. Zamorak uses his to form pacts with demonic creatures seeking to spread corruption and dismay. While Armadyl cowers from his, unwilling to fully shoulder  the burden of godhood.

Message.SourceString: Saradomin improves the lives of his followers. Through his wisdom he has turned civilisations away from tribal warfare and helped them to become thriving nations.
Message.LocalizedString: Saradomin improves the lives of his followers. Through his wisdom he has turned civilisations away from tribal warfare and helped them to become thriving nations.

Message.SourceString: As one of the oldest of the gods, his wisdom is honed across the aeons of discoveries,  unexpected crises and patient reflection.
Message.LocalizedString: As one of the oldest of the gods, his wisdom is honed across the aeons of discoveries,  unexpected crises and patient reflection.

Message.SourceString: His guidance helps us all to find our place in the world. That thing which each of us craves from the day of our birth, a need to belong and be useful.
Message.LocalizedString: His guidance helps us all to find our place in the world. That thing which each of us craves from the day of our birth, a need to belong and be useful.

Message.SourceString: Ah, looking to relive your moment of glory? Come with me down memory lane to face Kuldra again?
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, looking to relive your moment of glory? Come with me down memory lane to face Kuldra again?

Message.SourceString: Ah, good you're here. Your allies have already filled me in on your exploits, and I must say I'm impressed.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, good you're here. Your allies have already filled me in on your exploits, and I must say I'm impressed.

Message.SourceString: When you're ready, I will take you as far to Kuldra's lair as I can. You'll need to fight your way to the centre of her stronghold yourself.
Message.LocalizedString: When you're ready, I will take you as far to Kuldra's lair as I can. You'll need to fight your way to the centre of her stronghold yourself.

Message.SourceString: Not many people could stand up to the dragons of Kuldra's brood, let alone survive in a place like this, yet you almost make it look easy.
Message.LocalizedString: Not many people could stand up to the dragons of Kuldra's brood, let alone survive in a place like this, yet you almost make it look easy.

Message.SourceString: Now she turns the dragonkin's technology on the rest of the world, seemingly fueled by a mindless hatred for the rest of us.
Message.LocalizedString: Now she turns the dragonkin's technology on the rest of the world, seemingly fueled by a mindless hatred for the rest of us.

Message.SourceString: She's turned their machine into some sort of weapon, building wave after wave of discordant anima and using the veil over this island like some sort of resonating chamber.
Message.LocalizedString: She's turned their machine into some sort of weapon, building wave after wave of discordant anima and using the veil over this island like some sort of resonating chamber.

Message.SourceString: Each shockwave gets larger and more destructive by the hour and she threatens the mainland with destruction on a scale not seen since the end of the God Wars.
Message.LocalizedString: Each shockwave gets larger and more destructive by the hour and she threatens the mainland with destruction on a scale not seen since the end of the God Wars.

Message.SourceString: We must stop her, at all costs.
Message.LocalizedString: We must stop her, at all costs.

Message.SourceString: Well met, adventurer.
Message.LocalizedString: Well met, adventurer.

Message.SourceString: And what have the dragonkin done with that time? With that impossible history? They create monsters.
Message.LocalizedString: And what have the dragonkin done with that time? With that impossible history? They create monsters.

Message.SourceString: My name is Commander Zilyana, and I allow myself the personal pride to call myself the right hand of Saradomin.
Message.LocalizedString: My name is Commander Zilyana, and I allow myself the personal pride to call myself the right hand of Saradomin.

Message.SourceString: My lord Saradomin is the one true god. While others may profess to possess divine power, they lack the wisdom and the foresight that true divinity requires.
Message.LocalizedString: My lord Saradomin is the one true god. While others may profess to possess divine power, they lack the wisdom and the foresight that true divinity requires.

Message.SourceString: She has consumed more of the world's raw anima than anyone should be able to, and she has been forged with the blood of the garou's fallen deity.
Message.LocalizedString: She has consumed more of the world's raw anima than anyone should be able to, and she has been forged with the blood of the garou's fallen deity.

Message.SourceString: The dragonkin are older than the world. Indeed they are older than the universe, coming, as they do, from the iteration before.
Message.LocalizedString: The dragonkin are older than the world. Indeed they are older than the universe, coming, as they do, from the iteration before.

Message.SourceString: What would you like to know?
Message.LocalizedString: What would you like to know?

Message.SourceString: That tells you everything you need to know about them. With all the time in creation, and all the secrets they have uncovered in that time, they create armies of dragons to torture the rest of us with.
Message.LocalizedString: That tells you everything you need to know about them. With all the time in creation, and all the secrets they have uncovered in that time, they create armies of dragons to torture the rest of us with.

Message.SourceString: The five who ventured to Ashenfall are no different. Whilst they labelled themselves as mavericks and visionaries, they simply repeat the mistakes of their kin, and add an extra layer or two of horror.
Message.LocalizedString: The five who ventured to Ashenfall are no different. Whilst they labelled themselves as mavericks and visionaries, they simply repeat the mistakes of their kin, and add an extra layer or two of horror.

Message.SourceString: Her power rivals just about anything on this planet, myself included. Were the gods still here, I'm sure they could deal with her, but sadly the so-called "World Guardian" foolishly put a stop to that.
Message.LocalizedString: Her power rivals just about anything on this planet, myself included. Were the gods still here, I'm sure they could deal with her, but sadly the so-called "World Guardian" foolishly put a stop to that.

Message.SourceString: Yes, an iteration, there have been others. Countless others, stretching back across timelines so vast the entire history of Gielinor wouldn't even register as a dot.
Message.LocalizedString: Yes, an iteration, there have been others. Countless others, stretching back across timelines so vast the entire history of Gielinor wouldn't even register as a dot.

Message.SourceString: Saradomin was right to put his faith in you, just as we all were. You have slain the God Eater and saved all of Gielinor in the process.
Message.LocalizedString: Saradomin was right to put his faith in you, just as we all were. You have slain the God Eater and saved all of Gielinor in the process.
